questions.q: The hotel is old and a bit noisy. Be ___ as it may, it's in a great location.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Be that as it may*. *Be it as it may*, *Be this as it may*, *Be so as it may* — неправильні варіанти.

questions.q: I'm going to finish the marathon, come ___ may.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *come what may*. *which*, *that*, *how* у ньому не вживають.

questions.q: ___ it to say that the evening was a complete disaster.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Suffice it to say*. *Suffices*, *Sufficient*, *To suffice* — неправильні форми.
Застигле побажання — *Long live*, початкова форма. *lives*, *living*, *lived* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: I can lend you some money if need ___.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *if need be*. *is*, *will be*, *being* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: Far be it from me ___ you how to raise your children.
questions.why: *Far be it from me* + *to*-інфінітив. *telling*, *tell*, *that I tell* — неправильні конструкції.

questions.q: If you really want to leave the company, so ___ it.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *so be it*. *so is it*, *so will it*, *so does it* — інший зміст або неграматично.

questions.q: He is, as it ___, the father of modern design.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *as it were*. *as it was* — «як було»; *as it is* — «насправді, і так»; *as it be* — неграматично.

questions.q: Heaven ___ that the children should get hurt.
questions.why: Застиглий вираз — *Heaven forbid*, початкова форма. *forbids*, *forbade*, *forbidden* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: Every decision, whether it ___ big or small, affects the team.
questions.why: Книжне *whether it be … or …*. *is being*, *were being*, *been* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: They spoke in whispers lest they ___ the baby.
questions.why: Після *lest* — початкова форма (або *should wake*). *woke* — минулий; *will wake* — після *lest* не вживають; *waking* — неграматично.

questions.q: I'll work all weekend if ___ be.
___ that as it may, the decision is final.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Be that as it may*.

answer: Suffice it to say that we will not be going back
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Suffice it to say that*.

answer: Far be it from me to criticise
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Far be it from me to*.
